note: Before this deployment the live server answered UnknownOperationException for GetServiceToken and ReconnectRobot. Both now dispatch to real handlers. No pre-existing OOBE operation changed behaviour.

OOBE_20161026.GetServiceToken.message: Must be authorized under admin account

restartPersistence.method: systemctl --user restart phoenix-robot@moth.service, then re-probed. A real unit restart, not an in-process recycle.
restartPersistence.evidence: The durable account store retained the robot account Moth-Radius-Breazeal-Felt with both accessKeyId and secretAccessKey, and its loop still references it. A SigV4 request signed with those PRESERVED credentials succeeded after the restart: Loop_20160324.ListLoops returned the real loop with members, and OOBE_20161026.GetStatus returned {complete:true}. Persistence is demonstrated end-to-end rather than inferred from the file.
restartPersistence.note: This exercises an orderly systemd restart of the server. A robot-side power cycle and firmware-level re-attach are still not covered here.
